source: Native Codewhale PTY via qa_harness; website_current_terminal_capture sequence with a deterministic loopback demo provider
command: Run the opt-in launch_card_pty::website_current_terminal_capture test from the cucumber target built with long-running-tests, with QA_TUI_BIN and QA_LAUNCH_CAPTURE_DIR set. The real Engine edits export.py, runs three local Python tests, delegates a read-only review and captures six actual TUI views. Render the cells using web/scripts/render-terminal-capture.mjs; no cell contents are edited.
sourceProvenance: Development build from a dirty 0.10.2 working tree based on baseCommit; sourceDiffSha256 covers the tracked source diff and untracked source content hashes. This is a local scripted demo, not published-release or commercial-provider qualification.

conditions.provider: deterministic OpenAI-compatible loopback fixture (127.0.0.1 only; no external provider calls)
conditions.approval: Full Access for the isolated fixture workspace only

frames.state: configured provider manager with the local website-demo route
completed JSON export task, real local tests and delegated review in the conversation
a typed unsent follow-up in the completed demo session
actual /help overlay in the configured demo session
actual Fleet workbar containing the completed source-grounded export-review worker
actual Tasks workbar populated by the executed JSON export workflow

schema: {rows, cols, cells: [row][col] -> {x, text, fg, bg, flags}}; fg/bg are null (terminal default), a 0-255 palette index, or [r,g,b]; flags are rio-vt style bits (see crates/tui/tests/support/qa_harness/frame.rs capture_cells)
